newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices firm on thin supplies.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices firm on thin supplies.

text.p: Sugar firmed on Wednesday on limited supply due to restricted sales by mills, dealers said.
They said mills had been allowed to sell their free sale quota for December up to January 10. The December quota is set at 800,000 tonnes and for January at 650,000 tonnes.
"Some mills are holding back their free sale stocks," said a dealer. "There is also higher demand from neighbouring states."

Ready sugar S-30 rose 6.0/10 rupees 1,290/1,320 rupees per quintal and M-30 gained 10/25 rupees to 1325/1370 rupees per quintal. Mill delivery was up 15 rupees to 1,230/1,245 per quintal. --Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
